howToExport: How to Export and Host the Demo
exportStepGuide: We've included a step-by-step guide below, along with examples for running it locally or hosting it on AWS S3. Depending on your setup, you may need help from your engineering or DevOps team.
exportUnzip: Once the export is complete, a ZIP file will be downloaded. Unzip it to access the demo files.
exportRunLocallyDesc: Open a terminal, navigate to the unzipped folder, and run:
exportDemoUrl: The demo URL will be printed in the terminal once the server starts.
exportHostStatic: To host on a static site provider:
exportHostStaticDesc: Upload the demo files to your static site host (e.g., AWS S3, Netlify, Vercel).
exportSpaConfig: Make sure your host is configured for single-page applications (SPA), with all 404 or 403 requests redirected to
exportContentTypes: The demo assets require specific content types to be correctly set.
exportContentTypesFile: file in the exported ZIP with the correct mappings.
exportS3Helper: If you're using <1>AWS S3</1>, we've included a helper script named
exportS3HelperDesc: to automatically set the correct content types.
exportS3Step1: Open the script file and update it with your S3 <1>bucket name</1> and <1>region</1>.
exportS3Step2: In your terminal, navigate to the unzipped folder and run:
exportS3Auto: This will automatically apply the correct content types to all demo assets in your S3 bucket.
whatSupportedDesc: The Capturebliss demo export includes most features, but a few functionalities are not available when you self-host the demo:
analyticsNotTracked: Analytics - Usage analytics will not be tracked.
integrationsNotFunction: Integrations - Third-party integrations (e.g., CRMs, webhooks) will not function.
leadFormsNotCaptured: Lead Forms - Form submissions will not be captured, but the forms will still display and work for the end user.
exportLimitationsNote: These limitations only affect backend services - the interactive experience remains fully functional for your viewers.
exportQueryContact: If you have any queries, send us a mail at support@capturebliss.com
exporting: Exporting. This action might take sometime.
